searchText: Is it working yet. I had been trying for days and continuously getting this. I have 100's of transactions on mainnet. Someone mentioned it may have been a bug. just checking if i should try again now It’s a known bug. There’s currently a problem which makes your login session invalid if your browser fails to query the sequencer once. This is not intended and should hopefully be fixed soon. Right now you need to make sure that your internet connection is very stable and that your computer never goes to sleep. I’ve also noticed that some browsers reduce activity if your screen is locked, so might be also worth it to keep the screen unlocked. But IMO, the best would be to wait for the fix. Thanks alot man, i'm gonna wait it out then. good to know its a known issue Good name btw ha. https://twitter.com/trent_vanepps/status/1615038925382221856?s=20&t=2dNxq06mj2nX_oe80GZwtA <kobigurk> currently stuck on a "double sign" page :( <kobigurk> we found a workaround thanks to <@992497067878518875> :) I've contributed to the KZG ceremony in the first day, but now I can't see in the contributors list. I remember I see in the list just after my contribution is completed, and I could tweet about my contributions. Can be any problem in the list? <CarlBeek> what happens when you search for your ethereum address/github handle here: https://ceremony.ethereum.org/#/record <nicoserranop> > <nicoserranop> What is your address / github handle ? (re @kzg_ceremony_bot: <tux> I've contributed to the KZG ceremony in the first day, but now I can't see in the contributors list. I remember I see in the list just after my contribution is completed, and I could tweet about my contributions. Can be any problem in the list?) I searched with my Ethereum address and it can't find any record: `0x55aed0ce035883626e536254dda2f23a5b5d977f` <CarlBeek> are you sure you participated with that address? did you download a contribution receipt (`data.json`) at the end of the process? <CarlBeek> also when on "the first day" because the ceremony only started at 13:13 UTC and many contributed before then (and got deleted because of it). Yes, I checked my address from the template tweet and it's at 1.08 pm UTC. It might be before than the main start. I don't have the json file. Thanks. Why did it has restarted at 13.13? Was the first one a test? My contribution also got lost by the restart :( <CarlBeek> Ok, glad we got to the bottom of that. I hope you'll contribute again when you have some free time. 👍 also good on you for checking that your contribution is included in the ceremony, these kinds of checks are important to verify the ceremony ran correctly. the launch time was always set to 13:13 UTC on the 13th. I liked the meme of all the 13's. unfortunately this got lost in communication to a few people along the way and they excited started announcing "ceremony start" before that was actually the case yes, there was a big "Test Ceremony" text at the landing page we had hoped communicated that 😅 but you have +2 months to be included now Now, I can't stay synced to the website while waiting my turn. It log outs me after a few mins. Nice to hear I have lots of time 🤣 yep, we hope to have a fix for the logout issue tomorrow! Thanks! related to the logout problem, someone reported a similar problem in my client: https://github.com/jsign/go-kzg-ceremony-client/issues/6 Looks like the same thing, so I'll ping him tomorrow whenever gets fixed. <@420951281910284289> , from your last message sounds like the solution might be clear, but if helps looks like the sequencer returns a 504 status code before the logout. this is the fix if you'd like to reference: https://github.com/ethereum/kzg-ceremony-sequencer/pull/176

excerpts.author: skylenet
excerpts.content:
It’s a known bug. There’s currently a problem which makes your login session invalid if your browser fails to query the sequencer once. This is not intended and should hopefully be fixed soon. 

Right now you need to make sure that your internet connection is very stable and that your computer never goes to sleep. I’ve also noticed that some browsers reduce activity if your screen is locked, so might be also worth it to keep the screen unlocked.

But IMO, the best would be to wait for the fix.
